source_refs.note: Time of Flight: a main subheading of 2.6 Projectile motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 34-34.

blocks.text: The time taken by body to cover the distance from the place of its projection to the place where it hits the ground is called the time of flight.

This can be obtained by taking S = h = 0, because body goes up and comes back to the same level, thus covering no vertical distance. If the body is projecting with velocity vi making angle θ with the horizontal, then its vertical component will be vi sinθ. Hence, the equation of motion is:
